sloka: स तया ऽभिहतस्तेन गदया वानरर्षभः।भिन्नवक्षाः समाधूतः सुस्त्राव रुधिरं बहु ।। ६.७०.५७ ।।
transliteration: sa tayā 'bhihatastena gadayā vānararṣabhaḥ।bhinnavakṣāḥ samādhūtaḥ sustrāva rudhiraṁ bahu ।। 6.70.57 ।।

translations.english: Hit in that way by the mace, Rshaba, bull of Vanaras, with chest broken, blood flowed excessively.
